name: handshake
description: Two hands clasped in a handshake.
useCase: Represent an agreement, partnership or greeting.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: Solid cuff bands keep the complete palms clear; a small downward shift centers the lateral grip.

24.reason: Open cuffs frame the overlapping thumb; a small downward shift balances the full grip.
